notes: An uninstall now finishes. It removed the app folder and the shortcuts but left %LOCALAPPDATA%\DesksideRadio standing around them -- the folder the app and the browser profile sit side by side in, and the whole reason they are put there is so that everything the radio ever writes is in one place. Leaving that place behind, empty, after saying it had finished was not finishing. It goes too now, with rd and no /s, which only removes an empty directory: keep your settings and the call fails quietly and the folder stays, holding the profile. Only ever at the default path -- an install at D:\Radio has D:\ above it, and that is not ours to remove. The uninstaller also reads the way the installer does now: it leads with what survives rather than what goes, since that is the anxious question during an uninstall, and marks each step with a green [OK] as it lands.
